sender.onboardingBody: Dropsome is designed for small transfers to help friends get started with crypto.
sender.shareBody: Send the claim link only to the intended person, preferably over a private, end-to-end encrypted channel.
sender.cleanupBody: After the drop is claimed or refunded, remove the link from chats and notes for good housekeeping.
sender.refundBody: You can always recover unclaimed funds using the refund feature if needed.

receiver.welcomeBody: This wallet is your entry point. Use it to receive the drop and start your journey.
receiver.ownWalletBody: After claiming, create a new Solana wallet where only you know the recovery phrase, and transfer your SOL there.
receiver.temporaryBody: Since this wallet was created for the drop, it's recommended to use it temporarily and move funds to your personal wallet.
receiver.officialAppsBody: Install wallet apps from official websites or app stores. Always verify you're using legitimate software.
